messages:
mai: Canary A is live (tag=canary-2026-03-21-b). Kicking off post-deploy verification run now — running smoke suites across canary hosts.

deploy-bot: sequencer started id=sw-2244 step=post-deploy-smoke cohorts=3

chen: quick health check: overall p50=26ms, p95=230ms. Tiny 5xx blip 22:12 UTC, no 429 storm. A few outliers on embed.rerank route.

oncall-rita: I[0;31m see host-localized tail on eu2 (eu2-quant3). Stack traces show tokenizer init pauses and short tokenization GC events on startup.

infra-bot: autoscaler timeline: eu2-quant3 scaled down 1 at 22:07:10 and scaled up 1 at 22:10:05 during the change window

mai: running a focused synth for the short prompts C suite against embed.rerank (concurrency=3) to reproduce

product-sam: propose we trigger a tokenization pre-init (token-warm) and a small kv prefill burst on the affected hosts before we expand. If that doesn't flatten p95, we pin/rollback.

mai: synth run submitted: ```curl -s -X POST https://internal-smoke/api/v1/run -d '{"suite":"short-c","route":"embed.rerank","concurrency":3}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_KEY"```

infra-bot: synth job queued -> running id=sw-2244-s1 target=eu2-shadow

chen: synth finished: 150 requests, success 146, p95=280ms, avg=85ms, 5xx=4. Failures clustered to eu2-quant3-12 with identical stack traces referencing tokenizer:init and kv miss storms.

oncall-rita: confirming infra: that host rejoined after scale-up and shows higher syscall time + malloc stalls during first 30s of traffic. Likely cold token-cache + kv prefix churn.

mai: executing token-warm + kv prefill on eu2-quant3-12, eu2-quant3-14 now. Command: ```for h in eu2-quant3-12 eu2-quant3-14; do curl -s "http://$h/internal/token-warm" || echo "warm-fail $h"; curl -s "http://$h/internal/kv-prefill?set=short-c-sample" || echo "prefill-fail $h"; done```

infra-bot: token-warm/prefill job complete -> success on both targets

product-sam: re-running targeted synth only against eu2-quant3 hosts to validate

mai: targeted synth: ```curl -X POST https://internal-smoke/api/v1/run -H 'X-Target-Hosts: eu2-quant3-12,eu2-quant3-14' -d '{"suite":"short-c","concurrency":2}'```

infra-bot: targeted job finished id=sw-2244-s1b -> 50 reqs, success 50, p95=112ms, avg=38ms, 0 failures

chen: good signal; prefill + token-warm flattened the tail on those hosts. Global p95 back to ~190ms.

mai: decision call: hold roll-forward for 12 minutes to observe stability. Conditions to pin/rollback: sustained p95 > 260ms for >10m OR synth error rate > 0.5% with host correlation -> pin to v2026-03-20-22 and execute rollback playbook. Otherwise, expand to canary cohort B.

oncall-rita: Ill watch dashboards and stdout logs. Posting a short note to release notes draft: \"Transient p95 regressions in eu2 due to tokenization init + cache churn after autoscale; mitigated by token-warm + kv-prefill. No customer-facing errors observed.\"

deploy-bot: holding expansion until explicit approval from release lead (mai) or timeout at 23:00 UTC

alex: thanks team — leaving change window open til 23:00 UTC. Will post final thumbs before expansion.
